threads.body: These pytest dependencies are now unpinned, which can make CI non-reproducible and introduce sudden breakages when a new pytest/plug-in release lands. Consider constraining them (e.g., upper bounds or a known-good pinned set) or installing them via a constraints file so updates remain controlled (Renovate can still manage the pins/constraints).
threads.hunk:
@@ -64,6 +64,10 @@ test_deps =
   opentelemetry-sdk
   opentelemetry-instrumentation
   opentelemetry-test-utils
+pytest_deps =
+  pytest
+  pytest-asyncio
+  pytest-vcr

threads.body: Renovate's `pip_requirements` manager configuration typically uses `fileMatch` (not `managerFilePatterns`). With the current key, Renovate may ignore this setting and still not detect `requirements.latest.txt`. Suggested fix: use the correct manager option name so the pattern is applied.
threads.hunk:
@@ -4,6 +4,15 @@
     "config:best-practices",
     "helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver"
   ],
+  // requirements.oldest.txt pins exist to test against the oldest
+  // supported versions and must not be auto-updated.
+  "ignorePaths": ["**/requirements.oldest.txt"],
+  "pip_requirements": {
+    // Default pip_requirements fileMatch only allows [\w-]* between
+    // "requirements" and ".txt", so per-instrumentation
+    // requirements.latest.txt files are skipped without this.
+    "managerFilePatterns": ["/(^|/)requirements\\.latest\\.txt$/"]

replies.body: not right https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/, managerFilePatterns is a new syntax
